_purpose: User types. Test preconditions name a role id from here; test data must supply an account holding that role.

roles.name: Registered B2B user (any role)
can: sign in by OTP / e& Password / UAE PASS

roles.name: Customer Representative
roles.note: Role label shown per organization, so one user can hold different roles in different organizations.

roles.name: Organization Administrator
roles.basis: existing KB test user; Explore Topics 'Admin Users Management'

roles.name: Admin-Lead
roles.basis: explicit title only (Explore Topics 'Re - Registration by Admin-Lead with Expired LOA')

roles.name: Employee user
roles.basis: explicit title only (Explore Topics 'Employee User Management')

roles.name: Company Manager / Sole Owner
roles.note: Must log in with own UAE PASS; registers with Trade Licence.

roles.name: Business Representative (Delegate)
roles.basis: explicit (Registering on B2B Portal.pdf p2, p11)
roles.note: Authorised via Digital LOA by the company manager; paper authorisations are no longer accepted.

roles.name: Government Entity customer
roles.basis: explicit title only (Explore Topics CNAP chapter)

test_data_profiles._note: Definitions only: which data the journeys need, under which script variable names. VALUES live in the encrypted test-data vault (Automation Studio > Test data) and never in this file, its history or any prompt. `kind`: vault = values come from the vault; file = an uploaded document; external = held outside this system (e.g. a UAE PASS app). `used_by` is filled from the journeys' test_scenarios at read time; list extra users here.

USER_SINGLE_DEFAULT_ORG.name: Registered user · default organization
USER_SINGLE_DEFAULT_ORG.description: Registered user with a default organization set -- exercises the direct-to-dashboard branch.
USER_SINGLE_DEFAULT_ORG.state: Exactly one organization set as default

USER_MULTI_ORG_NO_DEFAULT.name: Multi-organization user · no default
USER_MULTI_ORG_NO_DEFAULT.description: Registered user linked to 2 or more organizations, none default -- exercises Select a Organization to continue.
USER_MULTI_ORG_NO_DEFAULT.state: 2 or more organizations, none set as default

USER_UNREGISTERED_EMAIL.name: Unregistered email
USER_UNREGISTERED_EMAIL.description: Syntactically valid e-mail with no B2B customer -- exercises 'No Customer assosiated'.

OTP_SOURCE.name: OTP source
OTP_SOURCE.description: Where a run gets the one-time password: a fixed test OTP configured for the test accounts, or a mailbox hook.

TRADE_LICENCE_DOCUMENT.name: Trade Licence document
TRADE_LICENCE_DOCUMENT.description: A licence file for the registration upload: JPEG, JPG, PNG or PDF, 5 MB or less.
extra_users: Registering to the B2B Portal (once authored)

UAE_PASS_IDENTITY.name: UAE PASS staging identity
UAE_PASS_IDENTITY.description: A UAE PASS staging account; the login is approved in the UAE PASS app, outside the automation boundary.
